steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds wonderful — a relaxing countryside weekend with your sister is always nice. Would you like help turning this into an email, a message to Maria, social post captions, or something else? I can draft/send an email or save it as a draft if you want.

Below are quick ready-to-use examples. Tell me which one you'd like me to send or save as a draft, or if you want edits.

1) Short email to family/friends
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body:
Hi everyone —  
I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored nature trails, soaked up the fresh air, and enjoyed the quiet. I’ll share a few photos soon. Hope you’re doing well!  
— [Your name]

2) Thank-you message to Maria (text or quick email)
Hey Maria —  
Thanks for such a lovely weekend. I had a great time exploring the trails and just relaxing with you. Let’s do it again soon! Love, [Your name]

3) Three social-post caption ideas
- Short & sweet: "Countryside weekend with my sister — fresh air, green trails, perfect reset. 🌿"  
- Poetic: "Trails under our feet, sky above, and laughs with my sister — a weekend that slowed time."  
- Playful: "Out of the city, into nature. Maria + me = weekend recharge mode: ON. 🚶‍♀️🍃"

Which one should I draft or send for you? If you want a different tone or to add photos, tell me who the recipient is and whether to send or save as a draft.
